note: Fixed JSON parsing vulnerability in ~/.pi/agent/extensions/agent-team.ts by adding a sanitizeJson helper function to remove control characters before parsing. Applied sanitization to all JSON.parse calls at lines ~190, 245, 333, 464, 521, 1309, and 1366 to prevent "Bad control character in string literal" errors when processing untrusted input from files and subprocess output.

Fixed JSON preference persistence bug in agent-team.ts by removing sanitizeJson() call from loadPreferences() which was corrupting pretty-printed JSON by converting newlines to literal escape sequences. Also added error logging to catch blocks so future issues won't fail silently.
